Officer's narrative
Driver 1 was traveling in the left lane on a commercial roadway in Katy, Texas, when the vehicle began a left turn
across oncoming traffic. Driver 2, approaching from the opposite direction, was unable to stop in time, and the front of
Driver 2's vehicle strcuk the driver's side of Driver 1's vehicle. Passenger was seated in the front passenger position
at the time of impact and was confirmed to be present in the vehicle by responding officers and by statements from
both drivers. Driver 1 reported neck pain consistent with whiplash and was transported for evaluation; the reported
injury is consistent with the mechanism of a broadside collision of this type. Two independent witnesses gave
accounts matcihng the sequence described by both drivers, and scene photographs are consistent with those
accounts. Driver 2 acknowledged the collision occurred as Driver 1 described it. Driver 1 is listed as a named insured
on the policy under which the vehicle is covered. Officers observed no prior dmaage to the vehicle, and no earlier
repairs were reported. It is not possible to determine from the scene alone whether all of the visible damage resulted
from this impact, and a further inspection of the vehicle is recommended to separate any pre-existing wear from
damage sustained in this collision.
